revenue.source: KONE H1 2024 report (FY2023 sales 10,952.3); KONE Financial Statement Bulletin 2025 (FY2025 11,245.2; FY2024 11,098.4)

operating_income.source: KONE Financial Statement Bulletins 2024 and 2025, operating income (EBIT)

d_and_a.source: KONE Financial Statement Bulletins 2024 and 2025, cash flow statement depreciation and amortization

capex.source: KONE Annual Review 2025 five-year table, 'Capital expenditure excl. acquisitions' (rounded to MEUR; includes lease capex, consistent with D&A including lease depreciation)

revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: FY2025 reported growth 1.3% (4.0% comparable); modest FX drag then recovery to mid-single-digit service/modernization-led growth, fading toward terminal growth. Not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 11.9% (1,336.2/11,245.2), up from 11.3% in FY2024; allow modest further expansion from service mix and cost programs, held at 12.5%.

tax_rate.source: FY2025 effective rate: taxes 334.8 / income before taxes 1,326.8 (KONE FY2025 bulletin)

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex excl. acquisitions 378 / sales 11,245.2 = 3.4%; FY2023-25 average ~3.3%

wacc.source: Assumption: European industrial, low-debt capital structure; ~3% risk-free, ~5.5% ERP, beta ~0.9-1.0. Not derived from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation/nominal growth proxy, below WACC

net_debt.source: KONE FY2025 bulletin/Annual Review: interest-bearing liabilities 1,028.3 less lease liabilities 455.5 = 572.8 debt (incl. 158.7 pension liability, not separated); minus cash and current deposits/loan receivables 1,708.9 = -1,136.1. Reported interest-bearing net debt incl. leases is -699.8.

diluted_shares.source: KONE Annual Review 2025: weighted average number of shares 519,087 thousand (A+B); diluted EPS equals basic EPS (1.89), so no dilution adjustment
